title: 3D Design Software for Woodworking & Furniture | PushForm
excerpt: Design cabinets, furniture and workshop projects in 3D with PushForm. Precise push/pull modeling for web and desktop.
content_html:
We're open source!

Design it in 3D. Build it with confidence.

Plan a cabinet, work out a shelving layout or try a new furniture design. Draw to real dimensions, explore how the parts fit, and make changes before you commit to materials.

PushForm: Shaker workbench

Push/pull simpleDraw, then pull it into 3D

Work to sizeEnter the dimensions you need

Web + desktopOne app, everywhere you work

Bring your own files

Start from the models you already have.

Open SketchUp models and LayOut documents directly, then keep designing in PushForm. Import STEP, glTF, COLLADA, OBJ, 3DS, STL and DXF. Export models as .skp, STEP, GLB, COLLADA, OBJ or STL, and Layout drawings as PDF, SVG, DXF, LayOut documents or page images.

  • SketchUp compatible. Open .skp files with groups, components, curves, materials, textures, tags and scenes. .skb backups open too. Export your model as .skp in SketchUp 2017 format.
  • LayOut compatible. Open and save .layout documents, with pages, layers, dimensions and model viewports.
  • STEP import and export. Exchange parts and assemblies with CAD tools, keeping names, placements and colors. Imported parts arrive as lightweight meshes; choose Make Editable to edit their faces.

See every supported format

Import

  • .skp SketchUp
  • .layout LayOut
  • .pf / .pfl
  • STEP / STP
  • glTF / GLB
  • DAE COLLADA
  • OBJ
  • 3DS
  • STL
  • DXF
  • PNG
  • JPEG
  • SVG
  • TIFF

Export

  • .skp SketchUp
  • .layout LayOut
  • .pf / .pfl
  • STEP
  • GLB
  • DAE COLLADA
  • OBJ
  • STL
  • PDF
  • SVG
  • DXF
  • PNG
  • JPEG

Open by design

Your tools should be yours to build on.

PushForm is open source under GNU GPLv3. Study the code, change it for the way you work, and share improvements under the same license. Commercial use of GPL copies is welcome, too.

The source is available on GitHub. Opening the software does not publish your private designs.

Explore open-source PushForm

Start with the shape you need

Draw it. Push it. Pull it. Done.

Sketch a panel, pull it to thickness, then add the details. Push/pull modeling makes it easy to explore a cabinet carcass, a tabletop or a custom bracket at the size you need.

1

Pull ideas up into form

Draw a circle or rectangle right on a face, then pull. A live preview shows exactly what you'll get before you let go, and you can type an exact distance at any time.

2

Push in to carve away

Push a shape into a solid to cut pockets, openings and clean through-holes. No extra steps and no stray faces left behind. Just the shape you meant to make.

Plan before you cut

Work through the details before the workshop.

How deep should the cabinet be? Where should the shelf sit? Build up your design in 3D, compare proportions and check the fit of individual parts while changes are still easy.

  • Start with real dimensions. Type exact widths, depths and thicknesses as you model.
  • Repeat the useful parts. Copy shelves, dividers and legs at consistent spacing.
  • Explore how parts meet. Combine, trim and subtract shapes to work through openings and joints.

Explore the design in 3D

See it your way

Present your work in its best light.

Switch from shaded to hidden line for crisp, drawing-ready views, or turn on X-ray to see through walls and check what's behind them. Change the look of your model in a click, without touching the geometry.

  • Shaded, hidden line, wireframe, monochrome and X-ray views
  • Edge, profile and back-edge controls
  • Sky and ground backgrounds that follow your style

Designed for doers

Made for projects with a place in the real world.

From a fitted cabinet to a weekend workshop project, use 3D to answer practical questions about size, spacing and how it all comes together.

Cabinet makers

Plan base cabinets, wall units and built-ins. Explore carcass sizes, shelf spacing and door proportions before cutting panels.

Interior designers

Lay out rooms, cabinetry and furniture quickly, then present them in clean, client-friendly styles.

Furniture & woodworking

Work out a table, bookcase or workbench in 3D. Size each part and explore joints before heading to the shop.

3D printing

Explore custom brackets, knobs and workshop jigs. Refine the shape and dimensions around the job it needs to do.

Product designers

Block out enclosures and parts fast, then refine with Solid Tools, Follow Me and precise inference.

Students & educators

Learn by designing something you can make. Start with Community Edition for learning, teaching and your projects.

Concept to creation

One workflow, from first line to final review.

Model with confidence, save your work automatically, and export drawings and models for the people who need them.

01 · SKETCH

Draw with intent

Smart inference snaps to endpoints, midpoints, edges and axes, so lines land exactly where you mean them.

02 · MODEL

Shape in 3D

Give panels thickness, position parts and add profiles with Push/Pull, Move, Rotate, Offset and Follow Me.

03 · SAVE

Save your work

Documents save automatically to your cloud library. Export a native copy to keep on your computer.

04 · SHARE

Get client feedback Soon

Send a secure link. Clients orbit, measure and comment without installing anything.

Plan your next build in PushForm.

Start with a cabinet, a shelf or an idea for the workshop.
